subject.title: fix(msteams): reset sessions on app removal lifecycle

question: Should resetSessionEntryLifecycle become the permanent public Plugin SDK contract for externally signaled session boundaries?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proven, but exposing a new session mutation operation permanently commits OpenClaw to plugin ownership, harness handoff, rollback, and compatibility semantics that require human API direction.

options.title: Approve the scoped public API
options.body: Accept the owner-coordinated operation as the canonical plugin lifecycle-reset seam, refresh the branch, and merge after final checks.

options.title: Keep the seam internal
options.body: Refactor the reset operation behind a bundled/internal runtime boundary so Microsoft Teams can use it without adding a permanent external Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped public API
recommendation.body: Accept the owner-coordinated operation as the canonical plugin lifecycle-reset seam, refresh the branch, and merge after final checks.

likelyOwner.reason: They contributed the current scope restriction and are the clearest directly engaged reviewer for the session and Plugin SDK boundary.
